Here are the step-by-step solutions for each problem.

**[id 190]**
John collects for 3 hours.
Convert hours to minutes: $3 \text{ hours} \times 60 \text{ minutes/hour} = 180 \text{ minutes}$.
Rate is 2 peaches per minute.
Total peaches = $180 \text{ minutes} \times 2 \text{ peaches/minute} = 360$.

**[id 191]**
A single duck eats 3.5 pounds of insects per week.
Flock of 10 ducks: $10 \times 3.5 = 35$ pounds per week.
Convert to daily consumption: $35 \text{ pounds} / 7 \text{ days} = 5$ pounds per day.

**[id 192]**
Initial trees: 50.
Over 10 years, Tom plants 10 trees/year and chops down 2 trees/year.
Net change per year = $10 - 2 = 8$ trees.
Total net change over 10 years = $10 \times 8 = 80$ trees.
Trees before death = $50 + 80 = 130$ trees.
30% of the trees die: $130 \times 0.30 = 39$ trees die.
Trees left = $130 - 39 = 91$.

**[id 193]**
Friday morning: 18 pink flamingos.
Saturday morning:
- Take back 1/3 of 18 = 6 flamingos. These become white.
- Remaining pink flamingos = $18 - 6 = 12$.
- White flamingos added = 6.
Sunday morning:
- Add 18 pink flamingos.
- Total pink = $12 \text{ (from Fri)} + 18 \text{ (from Sun)} = 30$.
- Total white = 6 (remains constant).
Difference = $\text{Pink} - \text{White} = 30 - 6 = 24$.

**[id 194]**
Violetta needs 5 crayons.
Cost per crayon = $2.
Total cost = $5 \times 2 = \$10$.
She prepared $20.
Change = $\$20 - \$10 = \$10$.
The question asks for the amount of change. The numerical value is 10.

**[id 195]**
Pencil cost = $1.20.
Eraser cost = $0.30.
Pen cost = Pencil + Eraser = $1.20 + $0.30 = $1.50.
Cost of 8 pens = $8 \times 1.50 = 12.00$.
The question asks for the cost, which is 12.

**[id 196]**
Total carrots = 200 pounds.
Number of restaurants = 40.
Carrots per restaurant = 2 pounds.
Total carrots used = $40 \times 2 = 80$ pounds.
Carrots not used = $200 - 80 = 120$ pounds.

**[id 197]**
Total inhabitants = 23,786.
Men = 8,417.
Women = 9,092.
Total adults = $8,417 + 9,092 = 17,509$.
Children = Total inhabitants - Total adults.
Children = $23,786 - 17,509 = 6,277$.

**[id 198]**
Initial cards: 20.
First month collected: $3 \times 20 = 60$.
Second month collected: $60 - 20 = 40$.
First + Second month: $60 + 40 = 100$.
Third month collected: $2 \times 100 = 200$.
Total cards now = Initial + Month 1 + Month 2 + Month 3.
Total = $20 + 60 + 40 + 200 = 320$.

**[id 199]**
Total sentences = 1000.
Mark edits an equal number for Publisher A and Publisher B.
Sentences for A = $1000 / 2 = 500$.
Sentences for B = $1000 / 2 = 500$.
Rate for Publisher A = 5 cents/sentence.
Rate for Publisher B = $2 \times 5 = 10$ cents/sentence.
Earnings from A = $500 \times 5 = 2500$ cents.
Earnings from B = $500 \times 10 = 5000$ cents.
Total earnings = $2500 + 5000 = 7500$ cents.
